head.title: map3d — real-time 3D cartography for React
head.description: React library for real-time 3D maps: photorealistic globe, DOM markers and clusters, a Figma-style drawing editor, live viewport-driven data.
head.ogDescription: An imperative Three.js engine that React mounts and stays out of. Photorealistic globe, DOM markers, drawing editor, live data.

hero.title:
Real-time 3D
cartography
for React
hero.lede: An imperative Three.js engine that React mounts and then stays out of. MapEngine owns the camera, the tiles and the layers, so the frame loop never waits on a re-render.
hero.shotAlt: A photorealistic 3D city rendered by map3d, with the drawing editor open over it

demos.title: Run it in the browser
demos.lede: No install, no key. The demos below are built from this repository on every push and served straight from GitHub Pages.
demos.reactText: A 3D map with severity-clustered alerts refetched on move, animated agents with camera follow, zones, the full drawing editor, a light/dark toggle and an alternative neon theme.
demos.reactShotAlt: The React demo: drawing editor, marquee selection and a live marker list
demos.reactNote: Published without a Cesium Ion token, so it opens on the self-hosted basemap — everything else runs. For the photorealistic globe, clone the repository, set VITE_CESIUM_ION_TOKEN and switch providers.tiles3d.provider to external.

caps.title: What ships in the box
caps.lede: Every surface — toolbar, controls, search, coordinate grid, clustering — is mounted inside <Map> and driven by configuration. You add the data.
caps.tilesText: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles through Cesium Ion, an ellipsoid globe when no token is set, and a 2D basemap that runs from Google or your own XYZ server.
caps.markersText: Real DOM nodes with native hover, focus and CSS animation. Pooled and written in a single translate3d pass; a moving agent glides instead of being recreated.
caps.drawingText: Marquee and lasso selection, resize and rotate handles, per-tool styles, undo/redo, GeoJSON in and out.
caps.dataText: Bounding-box refetch as the camera moves, plus real-time updates.
caps.symbolsText: The 9 MB symbology SDK is loaded on demand — it never enters a bundle that shows no symbols.
caps.themeText: Light and dark, prefers-reduced-motion honoured, fully translatable. No hard-coded string or value anywhere.

start.title: A clustered map in a dozen lines
start.plugins: Optional plugins — IGN Géoplateforme, Windy, indoor floor plans — live in a separate repository, and you can write your own with the plugin API.
